meta.name: skill-finder
meta.description: Find the right Affitor skill for your goal. Triggers on: "which skill should I use", "find me a skill", "what skills are available", "help me choose a skill", "skill for SEO", "skill for email", "explore skills", "I'm new to Affitor", "what can Affitor do", "search skills", "skill for blog writing", "skill for landing pages", "skill for analytics".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找到最适合你的 Affitor 技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你不确定该用哪个 Affitor 技能来完成目标。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly find the best Affitor skill for your goal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are unsure which Affitor skill to use for your task.

howto.what: 装好后，当你询问“用什么技能”或“能做什么”时，Claude会搜索并推荐匹配的Affitor技能，给出排名列表、描述和用法示例。
howto.when: 当你说“推荐技能”、“找技能”、“SEO用什么技能”等，或表示不熟悉Affitor、想探索可用技能时触发。

say.text: 推荐一个写博客的Affitor技能
say.note: Claude会搜索并展示相关技能及用法。
Claude会列出SEO相关技能及排序。

say.text: 我是新手，该从哪里开始？
say.note: Claude会推荐入门路径和第一步技能。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude acts as a skill finder: upon request, it searches and ranks matching Affitor skills with descriptions, inputs, and example prompts, helping you discover the right tool for your goal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "which skill should I use", "find me a skill", "what skills are available", or express a need like "skill for SEO" or "I'm new to Affitor".

say_en.text: Find me a skill to write a blog post.
say_en.note: Searches and shows blogging skills with prompts.
Lists SEO-related skills ranked by relevance.

say_en.text: I'm new to Affitor, where do I start?
say_en.note: Recommends a beginner path and first skills.
